messages:
emily-finance: Heads up — invoice INV-8921 failed to collect. Customer (Acme Labs) updated card in portal but Stripe shows `insufficient_funds` and `cardholder_action_required` (3DS). Customer says they completed update. Can payments team try a retry or advise next steps? cc @sam-payments @dan-support

sam-payments: Thanks Emily. Our auto-retry policy is: attempt immediately, then +24h, then +72h (3 attempts total). System flagged `cardholder_action_required` which means Stripe expects an authentication flow (3DS). If customer updated card but didn't complete auth, retries will keep failing.

sam-payments: Two options: 1) Send a hosted payment link for the invoice (forces fresh auth) or 2) do a manual collect once customer confirms they've completed 3DS on their bank side. Prefer (1) for EU cards.

sam-payments: Quick Stripe CLI for a manual attempt (do not run without ops):
```
stripe invoices pay INV-8921 --payment_method pm_XXXX --expand payment_intent
```
Note: manual collect may trigger a card network authorization if the card requires 3DS; customer will see the challenge in their bank app.

nora-ops: FYI, we saw a bunch of similar failures this morning after the 03:00 deploy — some customers reported portal tokenization succeeded but auth step timed out. Recommend waiting 24h after token update before forcing a collect so the bank has time to issue proper auth records.

emily-finance: Understood. One more question from accounting: when we retry/collect, when are merchant fees recognized? Do fees hit at initial invoice or only on settlement? Need to note for the reconciliation report.

dan-support: Merchant processing fees are recognized on settlement. So if a retry eventually succeeds but settles two days later, fees for that transaction show when the acquirer settles. For GL, record as "expected fee" on invoice but adjust on settlement.

sam-payments: Correct. Also if we do manual collect and then refund (customer disputes), we need to route to disputes team — that impacts fees too.

billing-bot: Auto-retry scheduled: attempts queued at 2215559000, 2215645400, 2215904600. Current attempt_count=1.

emily-finance: OK. I'll send the hosted payment link to the customer and ask them to complete auth. If they confirm it's done and we still fail, can I get approval to do manual collect after 24h?

mike-cfo: +1 to manual collect after 24h confirmed by customer. No fee waivers unless they escalate — route to me. :thumbsup: 

sam-payments: Sounds good. Emily — DM me the customer id when you send the link and I'll monitor Stripe logs for the auth flow.

emily-finance: Will do. I also filed a quick note for reconciliation: "INV-8921 pending retry — awaiting 3DS completion; do not close until settled."

emily-finance: Thanks all. I'll update thread when customer responds.
